name: autosomal dominant palmoplantar keratoderma and congenital alopecia
description: Autosomal dominant palmoplantar keratoderma with congenital alopecia (PPK-CA) is a rare genetic skin disorder characterized by absence of scalp and body hair and palmoplantar keratoderma, without other hand complications.
